title: ononis pendula subsp. munbyi
intro: Ononis pendula subsp. munbyi, commonly known as Munby's spiny restharrow, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Munby's spiny restharrow include reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and potentially lowering blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
